task: AI-generated versus real; compression preserves labels
source: https://zenodo.org/records/10066460 + local Hugging Face snapshots (OpenFakeTiny, Tiny-GenImage)
training: Frozen SigLIP, new v3 head; modern generator cohorts plus reused v2 features; four both-label JPEG/resize views

test_metrics.note: Sampled source-scene experiment; dependent generated variants are not independent scenes. Scores are uncalibrated.

evaluation_scope: Local frozen-head study with source-scene grouping and JPEG/resize stress; fresh test is modern-generator dominated, uncalibrated and not certified for every generator.
limitations: Frozen image encoder with a newly trained image classification head, not a fully fine-tuned backbone.
Adds modern generator families (gpt-image/Imagen/MJ v6-7/flux/SD3.5 era, ADM/BigGAN/GLIDE/VQDM/Wukong) but still cannot cover every modern image generation system.
Source/prompt groups and pHash distance<=6 families share folds; unknown different scenes/bursts may still overlap.
Publisher pretrained encoder training-set overlap cannot be fully audited.
JPEG/resize proxies are not actual WhatsApp transport tests; ground truth stays unchanged.
All scores are uncalibrated model support, not proof or guaranteed authenticity probabilities.
Face-swap additions (OpenForensics / DF40) are reported only when their sources are wired in; DeepFakeFace remains diagnostic-only.
Real-photo test cohort is still smaller than the fake cohorts; source-specific shortcuts still limit generalization.
Old observed tests (v1 and v2) are diagnostic only; no fresh test used for selection.
Non-commercial academic datasets: retain citations/licences and do not redistribute raw images.
licences: RAISE non-commercial research and education; preserve licence and cite authors

video_test_metrics_clean.interval_note: Bootstrap source groups; tiny cohorts and unknown cross-source overlap limit inference. Wilson interval assumes independent examples.
